policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 15. Record five confirmed mathematics, medicine, information theory, mathematical physics, and surgery science targets as verify-only science_retained checkpoints. No Person domain write is requested; all five must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Choose a low-ambiguity science cohort whose live Production value is knowledge and whose latest numbered-batch assignment provenance is established. Exclude unresolved Human Authoring origins and genuine philosophy-science, religion-science, or applied technology boundary cases.

science_retained.basis: Euclid's representative identity is mathematics, especially the systematic geometry and mathematical proof tradition of the Elements. Under v2, mathematics and formal inquiry belong to science.
Heo Jun's representative identity is medicine: he served as a royal physician and authored major medical works including Donguibogam. Under v2, medicine belongs to science.

Shannon's representative identity is the mathematical theory of information and communication. His foundational work established information theory as a scientific and mathematical field; the representative domain is science rather than applied hardware engineering.
Bošković's representative identity is mathematical physics, astronomy, and mathematical scientific inquiry. His main work lies in mathematical physics, placing him in v2 science.

Al-Zahrawi's representative identity is medicine and surgery, especially the medical encyclopedia Kitab al-Tasrif and systematic surgical practice and instrumentation. Under v2, medicine belongs to science.
